propositions: The supports_temperature override table listed only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7, leaving rebar's DEFAULT model claude-opus-4-8 unguarded so any configured temperature would hard-fail with a 400.
The rejection is family-wide across the opus line and affects both us. and global. profile prefixes, so per-id keys must cover both or match on the family portion.

Non-default temperatures (0.0, 0.5) are rejected while temp=1.0 (the API default) succeeds, so the mechanism is loss of sampling tunability, not lack of temperature support; the field name supports_temperature misdescribes it.
top_p is also deprecated on opus-4-8 and confirmed server-side, but is latent because rebar never sets top_p; there is no supports_top_p on the capability record.
The defect is live on the direct-Anthropic path too: anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 still sent temperature, so code-review Pass-2 pinned temperature=0 for determinism silently resampled in production.

Fix adds bare ids claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 to the override table (keyed on stripped id) covering both Anthropic and Bedrock paths, with tests per covered id and one asserting sonnet-4-6 retains temperature.
